motion_rule: the world rushes at him: the belt, luggage and crowd surge into the lens every beat, his face to the lens; shot size never wider than waist-up, new each beat; one action per beat, the hero always driving it; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a tiny fennec fox with huge radar ears and a naive face, muzzle free of paws and props
second_characters: ONE camel porter grabbing his scruff from behind; ONE meerkat tout with a receipt riding his shoulders; both huge at the lens, touching him, carried along
props: ONE crate on his shoulder, a golden mountain painted on its side, empty inside
prop_continuity: one crate only, off the belt at 0.85, on his shoulder till he hurls it at 8.30; only carried, swung, thrown, never opened for a look; one receipt, the meerkat's
environment: an airport baggage hall, midday, a carousel belt, a travelator, carts, animals packed shoulder to shoulder both sides
light_events: flat daylight through the glass wall, cold bounce off the belt, warm kick off the carts

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4.2 syllables/sec, beats filled
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to, za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.00-3.30 and 5.40-8.30 each one breath; after 8.30 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw opens wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows and jaw alive, muzzle clear of paws and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a travelator horn, belt rumble, hall chatter, cardboard on a chest

timeline.a: the belt slams the crate into his chest and knocks him back, ears flat, the packed rows tearing at the lens
he rips the crate off the belt onto his shoulder, flinching sideways at a horn
he sweeps the crate across the lens, the painted mountain flashing past, luggage hammering at the camera
a cart rams his back and drives him into the lens
he throws the crate over his head and shoulders through the packed animals like a bouncer, ears still flinching at every horn
the camel catches his scruff and he hauls it along on his back, both driven at the lens
the meerkat vaults onto his shoulders, shoving the receipt past his ear, and he drives on
he drags both forward, paws scraping tile, the crowd blasting past the lens
he shoulders two animals out of his path, the crate clear of his muzzle
the camel hauls back on the crate and he wrenches it forward, driving on
he rams a cart out of his path with his shoulder
he bursts clear into the lens, flinging the camel off ahead of him, the meerkat still riding
he hurls his own crate across the frame, its lid flapping open on empty air, face into the lens
the crate slams into the camel planted against the lens and folds him around it
he drives his muzzle into the lens, ears dropping flat, the meerkat swinging off him

must_appear: the mountain painted on the crate; at 8.30 it flies open on empty air; the gold comes off the belt, never the crate; at 8.95 it hits the camel in the chest; his jaw wide open on every line
